title: The Molding of Adam and Eve: The Counterfeit Likeness
description: How the Third Ambassador's revealed image, sent for the sake of the crucified Son, is seized in counterfeit by the archons whose lust molds Adam and Eve as a likeness imprinted with the divine seal yet not in truth. The simile of the noble free woman hidden in her palace; the four moldings — sea-bounded, fallen-on-earth, fastened-on-the-Boastful-Tree, and the new molding Adam-Eve as the conjoined product of the Exalted One's icon and the King of Darkness's matter.
